sources.entry: ItsPaint - Focused paint and screenshot markup app. Step badges, pixelate redaction, Instant Alpha. No account, no telemetry.

summary.one_liner: ItsPaint is a small, focused macOS paint and screenshot markup app with numbered step badges, pixelate redaction, and Instant Alpha selection, plus a UI-free Swift drawing engine called PaintKit.
summary.what_it_does: The app takes or pastes screenshots, lets you annotate them with numbered step badges, arrows, callouts, highlighter ink, pixelate blocks, and spotlight dimming, and drags the finished image into other apps. It includes a 13-tool painting set with brush nibs, selections (rectangle, ellipse, lasso, Instant Alpha), zoom and pixel grid, and snap-to-grid. Background removal works by flood-filling from the four corners to make the connected background transparent, without a model. Images export in nine formats (PNG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, HEIC, AVIF, PDF, ICO), and PDFs can be opened page by page and signed and saved back. Documents are saved as .itspaint packages that keep text editable. The README says the app requests no network entitlement and gives terminal commands (codesign, otool, grep) to verify this on a built copy. PaintKit is also available as a separate SwiftPM package for macOS 12 and iOS 15 and later.
use_cases: annotate screenshots with numbered steps for a bug report
pixelate or hide details in a screenshot before sharing
remove the background from a logo or product photo
sign a PDF contract and save it back
quick paint and markup on a Mac without a subscription
embed a Swift image-editing engine in an iOS or macOS app
how_to_run: Or download the disk image and drag ItsPaint to Applications (macOS 14 or later)
To build and test the engine from source: git clone the repo, cd itspaint, swift test
notable: PaintKit drawing engine has no UI or third-party dependencies and can be used as a Swift package
No network entitlement; README gives codesign, otool and grep commands to check
Background removal without a machine-learning model, using corner flood fill
Editable text stays as text in .itspaint documents until painted over
Signed PDF editing that keeps other pages and their text intact
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later for the app; the PaintKit package supports macOS 12 and iOS 15 and later
Before 1.0, minor releases can change the document format
Background removal only suits simple backgrounds; the README says it is useless on hair
Building tests from Command Line Tools without Xcode may need a manual plugin-path flag on Swift 6.4
